column1: # Boonie Bears: Blast into the Past (Nw9MIybVWzE): the English each Chinese line should show, by hand (2026-11-10).

column2: Where did this little boar come from?
Stay away!
My nose! It hurts! The pain!
What is it up to?
Happy Chinese new year! Wish you good luck in the Year of the Pig!
It’s a misunderstanding. I promise you.
What should we do? They are even angrier now.
What else can we do? Run!
Vick, what is this place?
Mammoth? Saber-toothed tiger?
I think…I think we’re back in the...prehistoric age!
BOONIE BEARS: BLAST INTO THE PAST
AN HOUR AGO[00:00:-01.-01] Dear visitors, please gather together. Closer, please.
Today, we are going to visit an important attraction at Crystal Peak.
What you see here... are prehistoric rock paintings, 30,000 years old.
30,000 years old?
That’s right. You didn’t hear me wrong. 30,000 years old!
There’s no more Mammoth, no more saber-toothed tiger,
but the rock paintings are still here, alive and vivid!
What an extraordinary…painting!
What!
Good! Wonderful! Oh good, good.
As we know, these primitive people often worshiped the mysterious.
This is the totem that they worshiped.
That’s just a painting of a bear, isn’t it?
How about that? Amazing!
Look over here! What is that?
Doesn’t it look familiar?
Bicycles?
Ancient people rode bikes? You’re kidding me right?
Their intelligence is beyond your imagination.
And there’s more! Look!
Have a guess. What is this?
What is it?
That’s not a hot pot, is it?
This fellow here is right!
Dear visitors, you know what that means?
It means hot pot originated from Pine Tree Mountain!
Good! Good!
Why are you keep saying ‘good’?
Are you a shill or something?
What kind of attraction is this? I want a refund.
Mom, look, I’ve had this before.
you’re right!
This tourist site is so cheesy.

You call this an attraction? There’s nothing but a bunch of rocks. You’d do anything for money, wouldn’t you? Tourist sites nowadays are going downhill. I told you we should travel abroad. But you had to come here.
An expert from Beijing told me these rock paintings are all real.
